name: OIFS Memory Sandbox
description: Local-first, model-agnostic single-file POSIX inode filesystem and MCP server in Rust for encrypted AI agent workspaces, CoW baton handoff, and numerical datasets.

interoperability.batonRelay: Instant O(1) CoW container cloning (`oifs clone src.img handoff.img`) and concurrent shared `F_RDLCK` read-only mounts across heterogeneous agents.
interoperability.cleanExit: Native OS mounting via `oifs mount` (pure-Rust FUSE ABI v7.28 or zero-kext NFSv3) and CLI extraction without proprietary database lock-in.

skills.name: Single-File POSIX Agent Sandbox
skills.description: Isolated .img workspace with read_file/list_dir pagination, atomic write_batch, rename_path, and verify_integrity.

skills.name: Authenticated Encrypted Storage
skills.description: XAES-256-GCM + AES-256-GCM-SIV filename encryption with OWASP Argon2id KDF and SuperBlock header MAC.
